jobs.description: Contributing to Core, CASABOT’s operating system for AI homes, with conversational agents, event-driven services, and connected hospitality workflows.
achievements: Own full-stack delivery in a startup, translating product requirements into system designs, tested releases, and production support.
Design Python/TypeScript services for LLM tool execution and event-driven automation, using RabbitMQ workers, bounded retries, and reconciliation.
Ground AI responses in authorized knowledge, enforce room-scoped guardrails, and evaluate tool selection, prompt injection, missing context, and unauthorized actions.
Integrate Oracle OPERA/OHIP, smart-device platforms, HubSpot, and Chargebee to connect hospitality, CRM, and subscription workflows.
Implement Auth0/OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication, server-side authorization, and Cloudflare-protected gateway access.
Deploy Docker services on AWS EC2/Linux, monitor application behavior with OpenTelemetry/Grafana, and contribute to CI/CD releases.

jobs.description: Delivered enterprise SaaS products across HRMS/CRM, property marketplaces, Fincore RMS, and ERP finance and inventory.
achievements: Designed multi-tenant HRMS/CRM with company isolation, 100+ permissions, 200+ REST endpoints, and a 100+ table schema.
Owned property marketplace backend architecture, including AI-assisted matching, bulk imports, and Bayut/PropertyFinder integrations.
Delivered Fincore RMS contracts, payments, KYC, and maintenance workflows with 55+ reusable components and 15+ master-data modules.
Built ERP finance/inventory APIs; optimized data access with Redis, indexing, and pagination, and added Socket.io updates.

jobs.description: Built banking, tourism, recruitment, and eCommerce applications across frontend and backend systems.
achievements: Built APIs and interfaces for banking, tourism, and recruitment applications using Node.js, React, MySQL, and MongoDB.
Contributed to .NET eCommerce development and API integration testing.

coverLetter.title: Cover Letter
coverLetter.opening: I bring 5 years of experience delivering enterprise and AI products, with end-to-end ownership across full stack development, integrations, and cloud operations.
body: At CASABOT, I work across Python and TypeScript services, conversational interfaces, event-driven automation, and production operations. My earlier work spans multi-tenant HRMS/CRM, property marketplaces, real estate management, and ERP systems.

My technical experience includes React, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, Node.js, RabbitMQ, AWS EC2, Docker, and DocumentDB. At CASABOT, I contribute to AI tool execution, knowledge grounding, authorization, and observability.
coverLetter.closing: Please find my CV attached for your consideration. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience aligns with your engineering needs.
